description: This PHP test class 'BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest' contains unit tests for verifying the behavior of the 'BuzzDao' class methods related to adjusting like and comment counts on shared posts and comments within the orangehrmBuzzPlugin module. It sets up test data, invokes specific DAO methods, and asserts expected counts based on repository lookups.

classes.name: BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing methods in the BuzzDao related to adjusting counts of likes and comments on shares and comments, ensuring the DAO behaves as expected.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by loading fixture data into the database before each test.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Tests the adjustment of likes and comments count on shared posts, verifying counts are as expected.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Tests the adjustment of like counts on comments, verifying counts are correctly updated.
